_comment: Mandatory protective slayer gear per monster (grZ field request 2026-08-08). Every row wiki-verified 2026-08-08 against the Slayer equipment page plus the monster's own page. Item specs are corpus names, optionally 'name#Version'. The slayer helmet substitutes ONLY where its component would (facemask/earmuffs/nose peg/spiny helmet, plus sourhogs per their page) - never for the gaze shields, boots, gloves, or the bug lantern. Cave horrors are deliberately ABSENT: Protect from Melee fully substitutes the witchwood icon (the card's mechanics explain that). 2026-09-17: a monster may carry several rules (one per slot) - the shamans' tier-5 Shayzien set; the CoX shaman row ('lizardman shaman (chambers of xeric)') is deliberately absent, the attack is dodged there (Andrew).

rules.note: A mirror shield or V's shield is REQUIRED - the gaze drains combat stats every hit, even from a safespot.
A mirror shield or V's shield is REQUIRED - the gaze drains combat stats every hit, even from a safespot.
Earmuffs or a slayer helmet are REQUIRED - the scream heavily drains stats.
A nose peg or slayer helmet is REQUIRED - the stench heavily drains stats.
A facemask or slayer helmet is REQUIRED against the dust.
A spiny helmet or slayer helmet is REQUIRED.
A facemask or slayer helmet is REQUIRED to kill smoke devils.
Insulated boots are REQUIRED against the electricity.
Slayer gloves are REQUIRED - fever spiders disease bare hands.
A LIT bug lantern is REQUIRED to harm the swarm at all.
Reinforced goggles or a slayer helmet are REQUIRED against the spit.

Outside the Chambers, a full tier-5 Shayzien set negates the shamans' acid attack (tiers 1-4 only reduce it) and its prayer-ignoring poison; the hard Kourend & Kebos diary lets a slayer helmet stand in for the helm.

An elemental, mind, dragonfire shield or ward, or the ancient wyvern shield is REQUIRED - it cuts the icy breath's max hit from 44 to 10 (Protect from Magic alone only halves it); the ancient wyvern shield also stops the freeze (wiki, 2026-10-15).

Not a dps pick: a Ghommal's hilt (tier 2+) worn stops the crypts' prayer drain (wiki), and nearly everyone who has one wears it here; the hilt-fitted avernic defender keeps the benefit. Pin another shield to override.
A witchwood icon is REQUIRED - without it the horror's howl deals heavy damage (wiki, 2026-10-22).
Boots of stone, brimstone or granite boots are REQUIRED in the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon - the floor burns - until the elite Kourend & Kebos diary's rewards are claimed (wiki, 2026-10-22).

_carried_comment: Carried slayer items the KILL needs (Andrew 2026-10-22): the finishing blow, best first - one rides as a trip supply even when unowned. The slayer unlocks (Gargoyle smasher, Shroom sprayer, Slug salter, Reptile freezer) automate the blow but still need the item carried. Ids from runelite-api 1.13.3 gameval ItemID.

carried.note: Gargoyles: finish them with a rock hammer (the granite hammer and rock thrownhammer count)
Zygomites: finish them with fungicide spray (refill it with fungicide)
Rockslugs: finish them with a bag of salt
Lizards: finish them with an ice cooler
